title: Unsupervised Feature Selection Using Local Intrinsic Dimensionality -- Extended Version
abstract: arXiv:2610.40736v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: High dimensionality degrades both the efficiency and the effectiveness of learning algorithms, and in many applications no class labels are available to guide dimensionality reduction. This paper proposes LIDFS, an unsupervised feature selection method based on Local Intrinsic Dimensionality (LID). The method builds on the formal equivalence between LID and the indiscriminability of distance measures. The data matrix is transposed so that each feature is treated as a point, and the LID of each feature is estimated by maximum likelihood from the distances to its $k$ nearest neighboring features. Features with lower LID exhibit greater local discriminability and receive higher importance scores. A refinement step then retains one representative per feature neighborhood and demotes locally redundant features. translated_title: 基于局部内在维度的无监督特征选择——扩展版
translated_abstract: 高维度会降低学习算法的效率与效果，而且在许多应用中缺乏类别标签来指导降维。本文提出了LIDFS，一种基于局部内在维度的无监督特征选择方法。该方法建立在局部内在维度（LID）与距离度量不可区分性之间的形式化等价关系之上。通过转置数据矩阵，将每个特征视为一个数据点，并利用最大似然估计从每个特征到其k个最近邻特征的距离来估计其LID。LID较低的特征表现出更强的局部可区分性，从而获得更高的重要性得分。随后，通过一个精炼步骤在每个特征邻域中保留一个代表性特征，并降低局部冗余特征的权重。最终得到一个完整的特征排序，可从中选取任意数量的特征而无需重新运行整个流程。LIDFS不使用……（原文摘要截断）
tldr: 提出基于局部内在维度的无监督特征选择方法LIDFS，将特征视为数据点并估计其LID来衡量可区分性，无需类别标签即可生成完整的特征排序，实现高效且可扩展的特征选择。
en_tdlr: LIDFS is an unsupervised feature selection method that treats each feature as a data point and estimates its Local Intrinsic Dimensionality to assess discriminability, producing a complete feature ranking without requiring any class labels.
